questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Fastest 50 (by balls)' in the 15/16 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Shania-Lee Swart holds it, with a total of 19.

questions.question: At which ground did Bernadette Greeff record their career-best bowling figures (5-19, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2023/03/18.

questions.question: "Tuskers" is the current name for which former provincial union?
questions.explanation: KwaZulu-Natal Inland was rebranded Tuskers (KwaZulu-Natal Coastal became the Dolphins).

questions.question: At Buffalo Park, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Dolphins or Badgers?
Tazmin Brits set a database record (22/23 season, combined T20 + List A) with a value of 89. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Fours', held by Tazmin Brits.
